Usage: musubix5 tdd source-supersession [options] [command]

Review, approve and record exact test-source supersession evidence

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  prepare [options]  Prepare a sealed review using unchanged current inputs
  approve [options]  Record dedicated exact-hash human approval
  record [options]   Admit and append a journal-first source terminal
  resume [options]   Complete only a sealed journal suffix
  replay [options]   Read an exact completed result without writes
  help [command]     display help for command

Usage: musubix5 tdd source-supersession prepare [options]

Prepare a sealed review using unchanged current inputs

Options:
  --root <directory>                   Project root / プロジェクトルート (default: ".")
  --json                               Machine-readable JSON
  --change <changeId>                  Explicit active CHANGE
  --generation <positive-integer>      Explicit active generation
  --operation-id <id>                  Immutable lowercase operation identity
  --test <testId>                      Exact annotated test
  --cycle <cycleId>                    Exact target cycle
  --terminal-kind <kind>               Exact target terminal kind (choices:
                                       "green", "refactor", "migration",
                                       "source-supersession")
  --terminal-order <positive-integer>  Exact target order
  --terminal-sha256 <sha256>           Exact target payload digest
  --old-fingerprint <sha256>           Exact target source fingerprint
  --requirement <requirementId>        Requirement within the active CHANGE
  --command <name>                     Unchanged configured selected runner
  --mode <mode>                        Review mode (choices: "test-only",
                                       "behavior-change")
  --old-block <regular-file>           Historical canonical block for test-only
                                       mode
  --hunk-review <regular-json-file>    Exact hunk review array for test-only
                                       mode
  --replacement-cycle <cycleId>        Independent genuine replacement for
                                       behavior-change mode
  --reason <text>                      Auditable review reason
  -h, --help                           display help for command

Usage: musubix5 tdd source-supersession approve [options]

Record dedicated exact-hash human approval

Options:
  --root <directory>               Project root / プロジェクトルート (default: ".")
  --json                           Machine-readable JSON
  --change <changeId>              Explicit active CHANGE

  --operation-id <id>              Immutable lowercase operation identity
  --artifact-sha256 <sha256>       Exact prepared review digest
  --approver <name>                Human reviewer
  --confirm                        Confirm review of this exact artifact
                                   (default: false)
  -h, --help                       display help for command
